mentions.name: Article-to-audio TTS cloud service
mentions.description: This cloud service takes interesting articles the user hasn't had time to read and converts them into audio via text-to-speech, so a reading backlog can be listened to instead (e.g., during a flight). Planned work includes UI improvements and a similar conversion flow for academic papers.
mentions.problem: Interesting articles pile up unread because there isn't time to read them.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a small cloud service that I've been thinking of for a while, to take the articles I don't have time to read but find interesting in principle, and convert them to audio via TTS.
mentions.author: xenocratus
